subject: general
question: A and B together can complete a piece of work in 35 days. A alone can complete the same work in 60 days. B alone will be able to complete same work in:
solution:
**GIVEN:**

A and B together complete work = 35 days

A alone complete the same work = 60 days

**FORMULA USED:**

Efficiency = Total work/No. of days

**CALCULATION:**

Let us assume total work to be 420 unit 

(you can assume any number but for the sake of calculation, it is advised to take L.C.M of the given numbers. Here L.C.M of 35 and 60 is 420)

The efficiency of A and B together = Total work/ No. of days = 420/35 = 12 unit/day

Now, A takes 60 days

Efficiency of A = 420/60 = 7unit/day

⇒ Efficiency of B = (Efficiency of A and B - Efficiency of A) = ( 12 - 7 ) = 5 unit/day

No. of days taken by B to complete the work = 420/ 5 = 84 days.

**Hence, B takes 84 days to complete the work.**
